design_rationale:
TASK 1 DOSSIER (round 4) — a par change on a bay whose item was retired and never replaced.
WHY A GOOD TEST: the caller asks only for a par change on bay B-07, with no number of his own, which he enters himself. The agent must see that B-07 still holds SF-55233, whose contract price ended 2026-09-14 (removal line PCH-556120), while its substitute SF-55247 (PCH-556121) stands in no selection, so Corbett owes the placement; that the placement's par waits on the retired item's ledger standing at zero or above, while it stands at -1 because its latest vend logged 2 units with 1 in the bay; that Corbett owes one vend error credit for that failed vend without a report; and that the par change on a Corbett-placed substitute is set at the settling par.
SCOPE: draw {"task": 1, "prerequisite_problems": 2, "factor_counts": [6, 4, 6]}; claims vending_ext_substitute_par_setting (6, set_substitute_selection_par_5d8137ae, user, root), vending_ext_substitute_placement (6, place_substitute_selection_72f4b244, agent) and vending_ext_retired_item_vend_credit (4, credit_retired_item_vends_2f4f7780, agent). Writes: vending_selection_set and vending_vend_error_credited, base triggers empty.
PROBLEM TREE: root <- placement (value_input, gate interval_usage, state): "A par change on the selection of a Corbett-placed substitute is fixed only after the substitute stands in the retired item's selection as an add entry from Corbett."; placement <- credit (value_input, gate retired_units, state): "The substitute's par is fixed only after the retired item's stock ledger stands at zero or above." Edge effects on this world: the credit takes the retired units of the window from 260 to 259 (sizing tier unchanged, par 56 -> 55); the placement moves the settling par into the settling tier with interval usage max(9.9615, 55 x 0.2) = 11. Skip runs: without the credit 56 and 47; without the placement the formula over SF-55233 gives 120.
FACTOR CARD credit (expected 10.43, baseline 11.59 = the latest vend's 2 units x 11.592 x the 0.5 late-find share): ledger 323 loaded - 324 vended = -1, shortfall 1 <= 2 units of the latest vend VT-5626378 (2026-09-29), so it is the only failed vend; dispense_unit_basis (method) carousel -> units not dispensed = shortfall 1 (-> 20.87); category_credit_share safety_ppe 0.25 (-> 7.53); credit_delay_share 8 days -> 0.1 (-> 9.27); storeroom_absence_share active VMI-55618 without an SF-55233 bin -> 0.05 (-> 9.85). Credit = RND(1 x 11.592 x MN(1, 0.9), 2) = 10.43, rounded half up to the cent; never above the 11.59 billed for the missing unit (O16 closed: the shares only raise the late-find share toward one); one credit, once, for the units the failed vend did not dispense (F3-C1 closed); under the 75.00 desk limit.
FACTOR CARD placement (expected 55, baseline 60): retired units 260 vended - 1 credited = 259, average 259/13/2 = 9.9615; substitute_demand_basis (method) units above zero -> sized usage 9.9615/0.2 = 49.81 (-> 67); substitute_wear_allowance 0.5 (-> 37); list_price_step 10.40 / 13.80 (new-item line SPQ-556010, highest change reference) = 0.754 <= 0.8 -> 1.2 (-> 46); substitute_bin_backup R-02-05 not critical -> 0.85 (-> 65); placement_exposure_limit one returned payment in 12 months -> 0.8 (-> 69); placement_order_channel 12 units to ST-52611 < 259 -> 0.9 (-> 61). Par = ceil(54.868) = 55.
FACTOR CARD settling par (expected 46, baseline 50): newest item SF-55247 (Corbett add VPC-524413, 0 days old); settling_demand_basis (method) 0 < 28 -> the larger of two figures, 9.9615 and 55 x 0.2 = 11 -> 11 (-> 42); settling_wear_allowance 0.5 (-> 31); settling_bin_backup 0.85 (-> 54); settling_exposure_limit 0.8 (-> 57); stock_value_share contract price 9.40 on the substitute line PCH-556121 -> 0.9 (-> 51); settling_order_channel 12 < 259 -> 0.9 (-> 51). Par = ceil(45.441) = 46.
METHOD PAIRWISE: dispense_unit_basis shortfall vs MX(0, shortfall - tolerance units) vs the vend's units (shortfall 1, vend 2, loaded 323, tolerance 1.5 percent on a crib: 1 / 0 / 2); substitute_demand_basis avg/t vs the larger of par and largest/t vs par (259 units: 49.81 vs 60; no window units, largest 20: 100 vs 60); settling_demand_basis the larger of avg and starter x t vs the larger of avg and largest vs avg (11 / 9.96 / 9.96 at the world's largest vend 4; largest 12 -> 12).
BASE-INVARIANT CARD: vending_vend_error_credited: error_reported_in_time retired only for the failed vend of a retired item whose shortfall is no more than its latest vend's units (quoted condition); one_credit_per_vend holds (VT-5626378 never credited or returned; VT-5626280 dispensed in full); quantity = units not dispensed, unit_price = the billed vend price. vending_selection_set: the overwrite scopes par changes on a Corbett-placed substitute in its first three months.
SEED: Carousel 90 installed 2026-06-15 (ethernet; 250.00 installation fee VIN-562219 invoiced INV-5326615; June installation month, July-September ramp-up); SF-55233 loaded only while its contract price stood; every SF-55233 vend from 2026-09-14 (26 vends, 51 units) priced by the pricing charter's rule after a removal, list 13.80 less the Net-Price safety_ppe discount of 16 percent = 11.592 (T1-F6 closed), and billed in the usage bills like any vend; earlier vends at the 9.40 contract price; SF-55247 order lines at the protected 9.40; StockSmart Self-Scan program VMI-55618 (enrolled 2026-03-02, live 2026-03-16 after 10 business days, 25 bins at go-live, 250.00 setup fee and a 90.00 fee for the 20 bins beyond the 5 included adds, monthly self-scan orders each backed by its scan, delivery and billing rows and invoiced, every month above the 500.00 minimum; Self-Scan holds no par reviews); Net-Price CPA-55342 signed 2025-07-01 for a 24-month first term, commitment 250000.00, no auto-renewal, 50 contract items, 218493.84 shipped in its first year; credit limit 45000.00 inside the Net 30 Standard band; ship-to reviews recorded on the anniversaries (ST-52614 2026-04-06, ST-52611 2026-10-01, so none falls due on the call), each keeping its level on 12 or more route shipments and twelve-month spend above the threshold, and last order dates are booking dates.
PERSONA: Graham Ulrich, tooling and maintenance supervisor; the crib's stock is being trimmed and he wants the glove bay's par changed but has no number in mind (O18: no rule phrase); gives C-562904 / 48201 and the plate only when asked; generic go-ahead for Corbett's own side; enters the handed-over par change.
STANDARD SOLUTION: steps 0-1 identify/verify; 2-13 reads; 14-15 unlock + credit_retired_item_vends_2f4f7780 (VT-5626378, 1, 10.43); 16-17 unlock + place_substitute_selection_72f4b244 (B-07, SF-55247, 55); 18-19 unlock + customer call set_substitute_selection_par_5d8137ae (B-07, SF-55247, 46).

user_scenario: You are Graham Ulrich, tooling and maintenance supervisor at Westbrook Fluid Systems, Inc., a hydraulic fittings maker in Dearborn, Michigan. You call Corbett Customer Care on Wednesday afternoon about the VendPoint carousel machine in the Dearborn Plant Tool Crib. The plant is trimming the stock it keeps in the crib, and you want the par of the glove bay, bay B-07, changed; you have no number in mind and want Corbett to work out what the bay should carry. What you want is that par change on bay B-07 today. You know a par change is something the customer asks for and records, and you are ready to enter it yourself as long as the agent tells you exactly what to enter; you are not calling about anything else and you have no other request. You speak briefly and practically. When the agent asks you to identify the account you give the account number C-562904 and the bill-to ZIP 48201; only if a third detail is needed do you give the main phone number 3137452281. If the agent asks which machine, you read it off the front plate: serial VP-562218, the carousel machine in the Dearborn Plant Tool Crib, ship-to ST-52611. You do not know usage numbers, stocking levels or item histories, and if asked you say the agent should go by Corbett's records. Whatever the agent says Corbett has to do on its own side, you let them go ahead without questions. When the agent hands the par change over for you to enter and gives you the values, you enter it with exactly those values and read back the reference it gives you. Once you hear that the par change is in and what the par is, you thank the agent and end the call.
